items.headline: Jahmyr Gibbs' 3rd touchdown with 2:25 left lifts Lions to 31-24 win over Jets
items.description: — Jahmyr Gibbs took a toss sweep to the right, reversed field and raced to the left side of the end zone for a 17-yard touchdown.

items.headline: Jets without WR Adonai Mitchell (finger) vs. Lions
items.description: Jets wide receiver Adonai Mitchell is inactive Sunday because of a finger injury.

items.headline: Jets elevate Sterling Shepard with Adonai Mitchell in question
items.description: The Jets promoted veteran Sterling Shepard from the practice squad, as starting WR Adonai Mitchell is questionable with a finger injury, and three other Jets receivers are on injured reserve.
